target_demographic: B2C: Individual travelers age 18-65, budget-conscious, tech-savvy; B2B Education: Universities (student services, orientation), high schools (personal finance courses); B2B Enterprise: Mid-market and large companies, remote-first organizations, financial services firms
core_pain_points: Current compliance training is boring and skippable; employees don't retain scam awareness info
Universities lack accessible, affordable scam awareness curriculum for students
Travelers have no interactive way to practice scam response before real situations
Enterprises need differentiated employee security training; KnowBe4 and peers offer generic phishing sims
recommended_hooks: Gamification: Challenge scoring system, certificates, leaderboards (vs. checkbox compliance training)
Multi-scenario design: Travel scams, student scams, workplace scams, social engineering (broader than phishing-only competitors)
Affordable B2B pricing: $1 per student (vs. $15-30/employee for enterprise platforms)

key_levers: Customer acquisition: Scale TravelSafe from 2K to 15K users (app store optimization, content partnerships)
B2B education: Enterprise school deals bundling all students (50 universities × $25K = $1.25M)
Enterprise workplace: Expand from 2.5K to 25K employees (SMB and mid-market focus)
International: Localize for UK, Canada, Australia (3x market multiplier)
